title: Microsoft to cut under 2.5% of workforce in latest layoffs, Business Insider reports
title_zh: 据 Business Insider 报道，微软在最新的裁员中将裁员 2.5% 以下
summary: Microsoft is planning to cut under 2.5% of its workforce in the latest round of layoffs ‌that could be announced as early as next week, Business ‌Insider reported on Tuesday, citing sources.
summary_zh: Business Insider 周二援引消息人士的话报道称，微软计划在最新一轮裁员中裁员 2.5% 以下，最早可能于下周宣布。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq post best quarter since 2020 despite Iran war
title_zh: 尽管伊朗战争，标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数仍录得 2020 年以来最佳季度表现
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended the second quarter on a high note...with the Dow on Tuesday adding about a quarter of a percent to notch another record high close.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市第二季度高收，道指周二上涨约 25%，创下收盘新高。

title: 'The jury's still out' on AI winners and losers, investor says
title_zh: 投资者表示，人工智能的赢家和输家“尚无定论”
summary: STORY: "This market believes in AI one day and then it's just scared about the spending. Now all these companies that have pristine balance sheets, not only are they issuing stock, but they're also taking on a lot of debt.
summary_zh: 故事：“这个市场有一天相信人工智能，然后只是担心支出。现在所有这些拥有原始资产负债表的公司不仅在发行股票，而且还承担了大量债务。

title: Apple is trying to address AI-related cybersecurity risks. What's going on?
title_zh: 苹果正在努力解决与人工智能相关的网络安全风险。这是怎么回事？
summary: Apple (AAPL) is reportedly releasing early software updates to address AI cybersecurity concerns. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley takes a closer look in the video above.
summary_zh: 据报道，苹果公司（AAPL）正在发布早期软件更新，以解决人工智能网络安全问题。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 仔细观看了上面的视频。

title: What to know about Anthropic's new Claude 'Sonnet 5' AI model

summary_zh: 市场主导主持人乔希·利普顿（Josh Lipton）追踪了当天几只热门股票行情，其中包括先进微设备公司（AMD）的股价在富国银行分析师提高了该芯片制造商股票的价格目标后上涨，而 Circle Internet Group（CRCL）的股价则暴跌。

title: Tesla Q2 delivery preview: Europe, international sales the driver as US sales in decline

summary: Tesla will report second quarter delivery numbers as early as tomorrow as the EV maker seeks another quarter of recovering sales.

title: Were the Mag 7 more like the Lag 7 in Q2 2026?
title_zh: Mag 7 更像 2026 年第二季度的 Lag 7 吗？
summary: As US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) tick up in Tuesday's session — the last trading day of 2026's first half — investors' eyes are on the segments of Big Tech that have underperformed thus far.
summary_zh: 随着美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周二（2026 年上半年的最后一个交易日）上涨，投资者的目光集中在迄今为止表现不佳的大型科技板块上。
